title: DASH/EROS : Feature / add export settings button
body: It would help people to be "more serious" with backups if there was an _export settings_ button shown at the end of the pod activation sequence.

comments.body: We can also update the text..."x days since last aaps back up. Please back up aaps to not lose settings"

You need to export after each pod activation. If you have a phone problem, do a new installation and then import old settings, not only you'd lose your active pod but also stress trying to deactivate a pod that AAPS can't reach...

It should not be let to believe that doing backups "whenever you have time" is an option ;)
